name: What kind of wear and tear can rental property flooring withstand?

mainEntity.name: What kind of wear and tear can rental property flooring withstand?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rental property flooring needs to withstand significant wear and tear from tenants, furniture moving, and potential spills. Durable options like LVP are designed to resist scratches, dents, and moisture. Commercial-grade or high-wear layer residential LVP and laminate products offer enhanced protection. Regular maintenance and prompt attention to spills are crucial for prolonging any flooring's lifespan in a rental unit, regardless of its inherent durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rental flooring should withstand heavy use, scratches, and spills. LVP and high-wear layer laminates are designed for durability, but regular maintenance is key.
